frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Animate vitality: the state or force of being a living, self-moving, responsive-sentient existent, in categorical opposition to mawt/inertness — covering (a) the state itself (ḥayāh), (b) its bearer (ḥayy/ḥayyah), (c) its conferral (Form IV), (d) its verbal invocation upon another (Form II taḥiyyah), and (e) its reflexive enactment (Form X: seeking another's staying-alive, or the living self's own felt sensitivity/recoil).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Animate vitality: the state or force of being a living, self-moving, responsive-sentient existent, in categorical opposition to mawt/inertness — covering (a) the state itself (ḥayāh), (b) its bearer (ḥayy/ḥayyah), (c) its conferral (Form IV), (d) its verbal invocation upon another (Form II taḥiyyah), and (e) its reflexive enactment (Form X: seeking another's staying-alive, or the living self's own felt sensitivity/recoil).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 184 confirmed occurrences the root contributes one thing: aliveness as active, responsive vitality opposed to deadness. In ~70 al-ḥayāt al-dunyā verses it names the current state of vital existence (always shadowed by the ākhirah contrast); in the ḥayy cluster it names bearers of that state, including God as al-Ḥayy (2:255) whose vitality excludes even sleep; Form IV (51x) is the conferral of that vitality — on the dead (36:79), the earth (30:24), or the already-alive who are quickened further (8:24, 16:97), showing the residue is scalar vitality, not the mere status of not-being-dead. The serpent of 20:20 is named ḥayyah exactly at the moment inert wood becomes a self-moving thing (tasʿā). The greeting cluster (taḥiyyah/ḥayyā) is Form II declarative: pronouncing continued life/flourishing on someone — the Quran itself repeatedly gives its content as salām (10:10, 14:23, 33:44, 25:75). Form X splits by construction: with a personal object it is seeking that someone stay alive (the six Pharaoh verses); with an an-/min- complement it is the living self's own vital sensitivity turned inward as restraint (2:26, 33:53, 28:25).
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: ROOT residue = animate vitality/aliveness. FORM layers subtracted: Form I V = be/remain in the state; Form IV = causative (confer vitality — on dead, earth, or already-living); Form II = declarative-performative (pronounce life/flourishing upon → greet), its noun taḥiyyah being the act of that pronouncement; Form X = reflexive/petitive (seek-to-have-alive with personal object; enact one's own felt aliveness → sensitivity/restraint with an/min complement); noun patterns: ḥayāh (state), ḥayy (bearer), ḥayyah (intensive animate individual), ḥayawān (intensified/true life, 29:64), maḥyā (locus/span of living), muḥyī (agent of IV). CONSTRUCTION layer does real work only in Form X, where object-type (person-accusative vs an/min) selects between other-directed and self-directed readings. CONTEXT (dunyā/ākhirah framing, rain-revival imagery, yuḥyī-wa-yumīt polemic formula) supplies evaluative coloring but no part of the residue.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The diffidence cluster — 2:26 (Allah lā yastaḥyī an yaḍriba mathalan), 33:53 (fa-yastaḥyī minkum / lā yastaḥyī mina l-ḥaqq), 28:25 (tamshī ʿalā istiḥyāʾ) — where no death-contrast appears and 'life' is least visible on the surface. It is reconciled internally by the Form X construction split (the same morphological shape carries 'keep alive' in 2:49, 7:127, 7:141, 14:6, 28:4, 40:25 with personal objects) and by 33:53's own contrast structure, reading the restraint as the sentient living self's responsiveness; but this reconciliation is form-mediated inference, not direct contextual demonstration, and it caps the result at MODERATE.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Residue = 'negation of death / biological existence-duration'. This covers the ḥayāh and yuḥyī-wa-yumīt clusters but fails three ways internally: (1) 8:24, 6:122 and 16:97 apply Form IV to people already biologically alive, so the contribution must be scalar quickening, not a binary not-dead status; (2) al-Ḥayy of 2:255 is glossed by sleepless sustaining power (lā taʾkhudhuhū sinatun wa-lā nawm), i.e. unfailing active vitality rather than biological duration; (3) it leaves taḥiyyah and the diffidence uses of istaḥyā entirely unexplained, whereas 'animate responsive vitality' reaches them through the Form II/Form X layers. A second rival, 'motion/animation' alone, fails the divine-title cluster and ḥayāh as a state persisting in sleep.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from m-w-t (its systematic antonym, co-present in 30+ packet verses — the pairing itself is evidence the residue is the positive pole, not mere negation); from ʿ-y-sh (43:32 places maʿīshah 'means of subsistence' inside al-ḥayāt al-dunyā in one verse — ʿ-y-sh names livelihood within the state ḥ-y-y names); from b-ʿ-th (event of raising: 19:15 'yawma yubʿathu ḥayyan' stacks both, bʿth the event, ḥyy the resulting state); from n-sh-r (25:3 lists mawtan wa-lā ḥayātan wa-lā nushūran — resurrection-unfolding is a third term, not the residue). Falsifiable: one confirmed occurrence denoting something inert with no animacy/vitality/wellbeing dimension (e.g. taḥiyyah as a mere material gift, or ḥayyah for a lifeless object) would break universal presence.
internal_discovery.rationale: Full coverage: all 184 occurrences read and individually assessed. 174 are directly transparent to the residue (life-state nouns, living-one nouns/ADJ, Form I 'be alive', Form IV 'give life', Form X 'keep alive'). The remaining 10 (Form II greeting cluster: 10:10, 14:23, 24:61, 25:75, 33:44, 4:86 x3, 58:8 x2 counted per tagged token; Form X diffidence: 2:26, 33:53 x2, 28:25) are reconciled without forcing via the declarative Form II layer (greeting content given as salām by the text itself) and the Form X construction split attested inside the packet. No occurrence is inconsistent, so universal presence holds and the result is PREFERRED; strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG because the diffidence cluster's life-residue rests on form-layer inference supported by parallel morphology and 33:53's internal contrast, not on an explicit death/vitality contrast in those verses themselves.

adversarial_verification.notes:
Full coverage read: all 184 occurrences accounted for. The core contribution ('animate vitality — living, self-moving, responsive-sentient existent in categorical opposition to mawt/inertness') is demonstrably present and distinctive across ~180 occurrences: the life-state N (al-Hayat al-dunyA, al-Hayawan, HayAh), the living bearer N (al-Hayy vs al-mayyit; aHyA' vs amwAt; the serpent Hayyah 20:20), simple V 'to live/not die' (7:25, 20:74, 87:13, 8:42), Form IV life-giving/reviving (dead, earth), Form II greeting as verbal life-wish (taHiyyah/Hayya, incl. 4:86, 58:8), and the 'spare alive' Form X (yastaHyiy nisA'akum: 14:6, 2:49, 28:4, 40:25, 7:127, 7:141). These cohere as one distinctive residue vs nearest roots (mwt opposite; bqy 'remain', xld 'abide' lack the animacy/self-motion axis), so the contribution is real and falsifiable.

Refutation: four Form X/N(X) occurrences carry HayA'/istaHyA = shame/modesty/reticence (2:26, 33:53 twice, 28:25). Verse-internal evidence in these shows a moral-emotional disposition with NO life-vs-death axis, NO self-moving living existent, NO opposition to inertness. The claim captures them only via disjunctive clause (e) 'the living self's own felt sensitivity/recoil' — which substitutes a different sense for the stated core. That live-conscience -> modesty bridge is a lexicon/etymology inference, barred as evidence by the HARD RULES; after subtracting Form X the residue that actually survives is 'shame', not 'animate vitality opposed to mawt'. This is forcing, not demonstrable presence.

Under non-negotiable root unity, these four unreconciled occurrences mean UNIVERSAL PRESENCE does NOT hold; verdict is therefore not SUPPORTED. Marked PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (not full REFUTED) because the contribution is a genuine, distinctive unity for the ~180 animate-life occurrences and only the HayA'-shame sub-cluster resists — but the specific claim of presence in EVERY occurrence is falsified.
